errata_10_items.v14_markdown_claim: Attributed V14 D2 R vs K solely to eager vs lazy maintenance timing
errata_10_items.corrected_fact: In V14 D2, R and K differed on 24/24 first-dispatch states due to batch-vs-chronological replay and `scope_unidentified` handling, so V14 D2 compared two complete organization policies rather than timing-only; v15 E1 unifies both onto one state-transition function.

errata_10_items.v14_markdown_claim: Claimed single-object removal in V14 D3 isolated marginal value of concept_0004
errata_10_items.corrected_fact: V14 `_build_d3_target_libraries` checked `isinstance(concepts, dict)` on list-shaped `KnowledgeLibrary.concepts`, leaving `concept_0004` in `concepts`, `abstracts`, `definitions`, and `definition_bindings`, while disabling reconstruction; no marginal object value claim is drawn from V14 D3 prior to v15's true versioned removal + billed rebuild.

`wrong_knowledge_transfer == 0` covers only false confirmations after adopting library knowledge (not extra cost or extra unresolved episodes), and V14's exporter read `scope_unknown_branch_ids`/`excluded_out_of_scope_branch_ids` instead of dispatcher's actual `scope_not_established`/`empirically_excluded_on_context`.

errata_10_items.v14_markdown_claim: Described H* as disabled by default
errata_10_items.corrected_fact: In V14, `_prioritize_generalized_families = False` disabled target-time H* Pass-0 scheduling while source-time H* construction in `autonomous_reconcile_library_episode` still ran; v15 §7.1 skips unconsumed source-time H* construction when disabled.

errata_10_items.v14_markdown_claim: Discussed Question A ordinary retry alongside Question B R_lazy_noH
errata_10_items.corrected_fact: V14 D3 Question B's `R_lazy_noH` operated on the subquestion-formed library rather than Question A ordinary retry's own library; A-ordinary and B-R cannot be spliced into a single end-to-end run, so v15 separates E1 (same history) and E2 (true end-to-end).
